summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent delivered a policy speech at the EXIM Annual Conference emphasizing economic security as a pillar of national security, highlighting supply chain vulnerabilities in critical sectors (semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, energy) and touting Administration initiatives including the Critical Minerals Strategic Reserve (Project Vault). The speech cited Iran tensions in the Strait of Hormuz (~20% of global energy supply transit) as an example of how supply chain resilience has become essential to withstanding geopolitical shocks.
